name: io.github.jcucci/dotnet-sherlock-mcp
description: .NET assembly introspection MCP server with advanced reflection and type analysis capabilities

environmentVariables.name: SHERLOCK_TOOL_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Tool profile to expose: 'full' (default, every tool) or 'core' (21 essential tools).

environmentVariables.name: SHERLOCK_SOURCE_FETCH
environmentVariables.description: Where get_member_source may fetch Source Link files from: 'known-hosts' (default; GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket and Azure DevOps), 'any' host, or 'off'.
